info.description:
Generated from the live handler mapping by OpenApiSpecIT. Do not edit by hand — regenerate with `mvn verify -Dnovocore.openapi.write=true`.

Every monetary amount, unit cost, quantity and rate is a STRING, never a JSON number. Sending a number where one of these is expected is refused.

amount.description: A decimal amount at two decimals, as a STRING and never a JSON number. A JSON number is parsed as an IEEE-754 double by a JavaScript client and cannot carry this value exactly. The backend refuses a number here.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Never defaulted, never omitted.

Quantity.description: A quantity at six decimals, as a STRING and never a JSON number — see Money.

Rate.description: A percentage rate at six decimals, as a STRING and never a JSON number — see Money.

amount.description: A decimal unit cost at six decimals, as a STRING and never a JSON number. A JSON number is parsed as an IEEE-754 double by a JavaScript client and cannot carry this value exactly. The backend refuses a number here.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Never defaulted, never omitted.
